Then $\angle ADC$ is equal to
hindi: माना बिन्दुओं $A,B,C$ के स्थिति सदिश क्रमशः $\overrightarrow{a}=3\hat{i}+\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$, $\overrightarrow{b}=\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{c}=5\hat{i}+\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$ हैं, तथा $D$ वह बिन्दु है जिसका स्थिति सदिश $\dfrac{\overrightarrow{b}+2\overrightarrow{c}}{3}$ है। तब $\angle ADC$ बराबर है
solution: m-n theorem: $(m+n)\cot\angle ADC=n\cot B-m\cot C\Rightarrow3\cot\angle ADC=1-4=-3$
solution_full: Since $\dfrac{\overrightarrow{b}+2\overrightarrow{c}}{3}=\dfrac{1\cdot\overrightarrow{b}+2\cdot\overrightarrow{c}}{1+2}$, by the section formula $D$ divides $BC$ internally in the ratio $BD:DC=2:1$.
m-n theorem: if $D$ divides $BC$ with $BD:DC=m:n$ and $\theta=\angle ADC$, then $(m+n)\cot\theta=n\cot B-m\cot C$.
originality_note: New: a triangle given only by position vectors in space, with the cevian point given as a weighted position vector, so the ratio for the m-n theorem must be read from the section formula and cot B, cot C from dot products (way 5: m-n theorem and section formula). Closest known: plane m-n theorem exercises with angles B and C given. Different because: the angles and ratio are hidden in vector data in 3D; the obtuse answer comes from a negative cot.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, side, angle and symbol is introduced before use, all conditions are stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked that the angle ADC is the angle between DA and DC (obtuse here) and that the options have one form. Changed: No change.
key_step: Reading the ratio 2:1 from the position vector of D and applying the m-n theorem with cot B and cot C from dot products.
justification: Routine chain of three standard steps (section formula, two dot-product angles, m-n theorem) with no insight; the direct vector route gives the same answer. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q1 (L2), above the section-formula checks of 2023-P2-Q4 (L1).

concept_use.m-n theorem: (m+n) cot ADC = n cot B - m cot C with m:n = 2:1 gives cot ADC = -1.
